tooling: Hand-maintained. CI's pip-audit step ignores exactly the advisories listed here (scripts/vex_ignores.py); SECURITY.md argues each disposition.

statements.impact_statement: Pre-auth RCE in ChromaDB's client/server HTTP API. chromadb is an opt-in extra, absent from the default install. When used, NeuralMind embeds chromadb.PersistentClient (local, on-disk): it never starts the ChromaDB server, never exposes the endpoint, and never sets trust_remote_code.
Authenticated code injection via a malicious model repository when trust_remote_code=true, through the ChromaDB server. NeuralMind runs no ChromaDB server and never sets trust_remote_code.
Missing tenant authorization in the multi-tenant ChromaDB server. PersistentClient is single-tenant, local and on-disk, with no authenticated callers to escalate between.
SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider ignores the scope of a permission. NeuralMind configures no ChromaDB authorization provider and runs no ChromaDB server.
